# ISO Certification Consultants Inc.

> ISO certification consulting for Canadian companies, with compliance management software configured by certified consultants. Based in Ontario, Canada, serving companies across Canada.

ISO Certification Consultants help manufacturing and service companies prepare for and pass ISO and sector certification audits: gap analysis, management system build, internal audits and support through the certification body's Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits. Engagements pair a certified lead consultant with compliance management software that tracks every clause, document, audit and corrective action.

- Contact: anthony.mannella@isocertificationconsultants.ca, +1 (416) 622-0022
- Free readiness check: https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/assessment/
- Certification process: https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/process/

## Certification consulting by standard

- [ISO 9001 — Quality Management](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-9001/): The foundation of every certified operation. Risk-based thinking, document control, and continual improvement built around your real production floor.
- [IATF 16949 — Automotive Quality](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iatf-16949/): The automotive supplement to ISO 9001, with the core tools your OEM customers audit against: APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA and SPC.
- [AS9100 — Aerospace Quality](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/as9100/): Aerospace, space and defence quality with configuration management, counterfeit-part prevention and FOD control layered onto ISO 9001.
- [ISO 13485 — Medical Devices](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-13485/): Design controls, MDSAP readiness and Health Canada MDEL alignment for device makers who cannot afford a nonconformance.
- [ISO 14001 — Environmental Management](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-14001/): Environmental aspects, lifecycle thinking and legal-compliance tracking that stand up to regulators and customer sustainability audits.
- [ISO 45001 — OH&S Management](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-45001/): Occupational health and safety built on hazard identification, the hierarchy of controls and worker participation — not just paperwork.
- [ISO 27001 — Information Security](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-27001/): An information security management system with a risk-driven Statement of Applicability, ready for the customers demanding proof.
- [ISO 22000 — Food Safety](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-22000/): Food safety management integrating HACCP, prerequisite programs and CFIA compliance for Canadian processors and manufacturers.
- [ISO 22301 — Business Continuity](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-22301/): Business continuity management — impact analysis, recovery strategies and tested plans that keep production running through disruption.
- [ISO/IEC 17025 — Lab Accreditation](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/services/iso-17025/): Testing and calibration laboratory accreditation with measurement traceability, method validation and competence you can defend.

## Industries

- [Manufacturing](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/manufacturing/): Discrete and process manufacturers building a compliance management system that survives customer audits and scales with the line.
- [Automotive](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/automotive/): Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers meeting IATF 16949 and the core tools their OEM customers demand.
- [Aerospace & Defence](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/aerospace-defence/): Precision machine shops and assemblies achieving AS9100 with configuration control and first article evidence their primes accept.
- [Healthcare & Medical Devices](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/healthcare-medical-devices/): Device manufacturers navigating ISO 13485, MDSAP and Health Canada licensing without stalling the pipeline.
- [Food & Beverage](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/food-beverage/): Processors and packagers integrating ISO 22000, HACCP and CFIA requirements into one auditable system.
- [Oil, Gas & Energy](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/oil-gas-energy/): Energy operators managing quality, environment and safety across high-consequence, heavily-regulated operations.
- [Construction](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/construction/): Contractors and fabricators winning tenders with integrated quality, safety and environmental management.
- [Mining & Natural Resources](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/industries/mining-natural-resources/): Extractive and resource operations proving environmental stewardship and safety leadership under scrutiny.

## Compliance management software

- [Platform overview](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/platform/)
- [Standards](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/standards/): Know your clause coverage before the auditor does
- [Documents](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/document-control/): One current revision, and proof of which one it is
- [Processes](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/processes/): Your processes, with owners, drawn once
- [Audits](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/audits-management-review/): Findings captured on the floor, not retyped later
- [Improvements](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/nonconformance-capa/): Every finding has an owner and a verified fix
- [Safety](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/safety/): Near-misses reported from the floor, before they become incidents
- [Training](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/training-competence/): Who is qualified, and the record that proves it
- [Supplier Quality](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/supplier-quality/): SCARs answered in a portal, not an inbox
- [Assets](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/calibration-maintenance/): Every instrument in date, every inspection signed
- [Vendors](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/vendors/): Every vendor's status and documents in one directory
- [AI Assistant](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/solutions/ai-assistant/): Does the task, within your permissions, with you signing off

- [ISO 22000 vs HACCP Differences: Which Framework Fits Your Food Facility?](https://isocertificationconsultants.ca/blog/iso-22000-vs-haccp-differences-which-framework-fits-your-food-facility/): Explore key ISO 22000 vs HACCP differences to determine which food safety standard satisfies Canadian regulations and buyer requirements for your plant.
